contracts.name: EcoFuturesAdmin
contracts.title: EcoFuturesAdmin -- who is who
contracts.notice: Identity and standing for every actor, and the protocol directory. It holds no money. Trust Admins (Holders) admitted, removed and replaced only by Council vote, through Governance Verifiers admitted by a Holder of their own country, in organisations bound to ONE Holder Standing suspension and dismissal of verifiers; the freeze of a Holder (Governance) KYC the identity check every buyer passes before bidding (the server marks it)
contracts.dev: HOLDER SUCCESSION. When the Council replaces a Holder, the old Holder's successor takes its fee and its authority over every covenant at once (Lifecycle v5 §12). Nothing is migrated: the verifier keeps its admitting Holder, and holderOf() follows the line to whoever holds it now. Only a replaced Holder has a successor, so the line is short and acyclic by construction.

contracts.name: EcoCountries
contracts.title: EcoCountries -- the rulebook: countries, their settings, and the flows they follow
contracts.notice: What a request in each country must go through and what it costs. THE FLOW, per country, as data: an ordered list of Steps, validated when it is defined. A country's five settings (Lifecycle v5 §5) are a flow id (registration timing and the power), the term limits and the listing window, plus the window after a sale for path B's recording. For example: Sri Lanka, path A, under a power POWER, POWER_ANCHOR, DEED, ATTEST, MINT, SALE Japan, path A DEED, ATTEST, MINT, SALE Brazil, path B DEED, ATTEST, MINT, SALE, RECORDING, ATTEST WHO CHANGES WHAT. The Foundation defines flows and enables a country with its first settings. After that a Trust Admin of the country proposes new settings, with the hash of counsel's note on the new law, and the Council decides by a majority of all seats (§5). A change applies only to requests made after it. Prices are not legal settings: a Trust Admin of the country, or a GTA, sets them directly.

functions.name: defineFlow

functions.details: The order rules, checked so a malformed flow can never be stored: - exactly one MINT, with the SALE immediately after it - at most one POWER, before the mint, and then one POWER_ANCHOR, also before the mint - every document (AGREEMENT, DEED, RECORDING) is immediately followed by its ATTEST, and every ATTEST immediately follows a document - documents come after the power is anchored, when there is one - an AGREEMENT only before the mint; a RECORDING only after the sale - at least one DEED or RECORDING: every flow ends with an attested deed in the registry - the flow ends with the SALE or an ATTEST

contracts.name: EcoRegistry
contracts.title: EcoRegistry -- every request, from the guardian's payment to its covenant's activation
contracts.notice: THE FIXED HEAD, the same in every country (1 Oct 2026): requestVerification -> claim -> submitVerification -> watchdog window (challengeable) THEN THE COUNTRY'S FLOW (EcoCountries), one step at a time. EcoDeeds records each power, document and attestation and reports it here; the guardian mints; the Bank reports the sale. A covenant is active when its flow completes: at the sale in path A, at the recording's attestation in path B, which is why the price waits in the Bank's escrow between the two. THE MONEY HERE is the guardian's upfront payment, held per request in four parts and paid as the work is done. Each part is zeroed when it is paid, and whatever is left when a request ends goes back to the guardian, so this contract's balance always equals the sum of what its requests still hold. verifierShare the land-scaled fee less the deed check -> the verifier, once the watchdog window passes deedComponent the deed check, V -> the attester of the flow's last document attestationFee the country's flat fee -> the flow's first attester judgmentFee the country's flat fee -> the voters of a pre-mint panel; otherwise the verifier, with its share

A test, not a challenge (1 Oct 2026). Who attests: a verifier in standing of the same country, from another organisation and another Trust Admin; or, once the backstop delay has passed since the document was recorded, a Trust Admin of the country other than the request's own, or a GTA (§3.1).

contracts.name: EcoFuturesCore
contracts.title: EcoFuturesCore -- the covenant, from mint to the end of its term
contracts.notice: Holds each covenant's identity and status, and runs the term: the bound verifier's re-verification once per release interval, blocking on a breach, the Trust Admin's unblock and cancel, the replacement of a verifier, and the switch of payee when the land changes hands.
contracts.dev: The term is the same in every country (29 Sep 2026: "everything from the purchase onwards follows the EcoFutures flow"). Money is the Bank's: Core asks it to release, and to pay out a cancellation. ONE VERIFICATION PER INTERVAL. The term is divided into release intervals; each verification covers every interval that has begun since the last one and opens a review window in EcoChallenge. Their instalments are released when that window settles clean -- attested, unchallenged or dismissed -- and held by an upheld finding, a breach, a freeze or a halt until a later window settles clean or the hold lifts (releaseHeld).

contracts.name: EcoBank
contracts.title: EcoBank -- the auction, the sale's money and the term's instalments
contracts.notice: Auctions a minted EFT to identity-checked buyers, settles the sale, and pays the instalments through the term at the settled 90 / 7 / 1 / 1 / 1 split. list -> bid -> settle the guardian lists inside the listing window, at or above the price floor; only identity-checked buyers bid; after the close anyone settles, which pulls the price path A the sale completes the flow: the covenant is active at once and the EFT is delivered (§4: "a completed auction is a completed sale") path B the price waits here in escrow, with the EFT, until the recording is attested; the Registry refunds the buyer if the post-sale steps run out of time activation the review pool (1% of the sale) goes to EcoChallenge, the first instalment is paid, and the rest is held and released as each re-verification's review window settles
contracts.dev: Bids are not escrowed. A bid checks balance and allowance when made, and the settlement takes the highest bid whose bidder can still pay -- so a bidder who withdraws its allowance loses the lot to the next, and never stalls it. The number of distinct bidders is capped, which bounds that search.

functions.name: bid

functions.access: Anyone; the function checks its own rules

functions.access: Anyone; the function checks its own rules

contracts.name: EcoChallenge
contracts.title: EcoChallenge -- challenges, panels and the review pool
contracts.notice: Two points in a covenant's life can be challenged: the watchdog window after the verification (the subject is the request), and the review window that each re-verification in the term opens (the subject is the covenant). Attesting a document is a test by one person, done in the Registry, and is never challenged (1 Oct 2026). raise -> respond (the verifier, once) -> seat a panel of three -> the panel votes; two matching votes decide. The challenger may withdraw before the panel is seated. Whatever is undecided at the challenge's one deadline -- response, panel and redraw windows counted from the raise -- lapses: silence never upholds, and flags nobody. Pre-mint dismissed the verification stands; the challenger is flagged upheld, score the verification is removed and the request reopens for another verifier upheld, documents the request fails and the guardian is refunded the voters share the country's judgment fee Term dismissed the challenger is flagged, unless the land was found in breach upheld, score the verifier and its attestor are flagged; the seat is vacated and the Trust Admin reseats one of its other verifiers, whose verification releases again upheld, documents the verifier and its attestor are flagged; the window's instalments wait for a better record in breach the drip freezes; the next verification lifts it THE REVIEW POOL is 1% of the sale, held here through the term and divided into one fee per review window (spec §10). A window's fee goes to: its attestor the window was attested and no challenge took it panel 40%, challenger 60% a challenge found something panel 40% a challenge was dismissed; the rest stays in the pool the voters 40%, shared the panel failed to decide; the rest as if unchallenged nobody nobody acted: the window counts as unattested Three unattested windows in a row halt releases until a window is attested or decided. What the pool still holds at the end of the term goes to the guardian.
contracts.dev: The panel is drawn from the previous block's hash, fixed at the raise. A challenger who times its raise can influence which eligible members are drawn; a verifiable random source would remove that.

contracts.name: EcoFuturesGovernance
contracts.title: EcoFuturesGovernance -- the GTAs, the Council, and the Foundation's controls
contracts.notice: The GTAs are the Council. Its decisions are made on chain: a GTA proposes an action, GTAs approve it, and it executes once a majority of ALL seats has approved (§3.1, §5). What the Council decides: ADD_GTA, REMOVE_GTA its own membership (the GTA being removed does not count) ADMIT_HOLDER, REMOVE_HOLDER Trust Admins, and a successor for a failed one (REPLACE_HOLDER), whose REPLACE_HOLDER fee and authority over every covenant follow it at once (§12) FREEZE_HOLDER, UNFREEZE_HOLDER a Trust Admin's freeze; RATIFY_FREEZE keeps an emergency freeze APPLY_SETTINGS a country's settings, on its Trust Admin's proposal (§5) SET_COUNTRY_STATUS suspending or resuming a country REVOKE_POWER recording a power's revocation; an unauthorised one freezes the Holder SWITCH_PAYEE the payee when land changes hands or heirship is proven (§10) REASSIGN_VERIFIER moving a request to another of its Trust Admin's verifiers CLEAR_PARCEL releasing a parcel hash UNBLOCK_COVENANT, CANCEL_ the consequences a GTA reviews but never effects alone: unblocking, COVENANT, NOMINATE_VERIFIER, cancelling and reseating a covenant whose Trust Admin cannot act, the drip FREEZE_DRIP, SUSPEND_VERIFIER, valve, and a verifier's suspension or dismissal DISMISS_VERIFIER The Foundation (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) seats the first three GTAs -- below three seats no majority can act -- and changes the fee split through a 48-hour timelock. The server (SERVER_ADMIN_ROLE) may freeze a Trust Admin in an emergency for 30 days; the Council ratifies it or it lapses, and the server cannot use it on the same Trust Admin again for a year.

contracts.name: Tree
contracts.title: Tree -- TR3, the TREE reward
contracts.notice: An ERC-20 minted only to the parties of an active covenant, as its term runs. EDITIONS. Active land is counted in land-years: hundredths of a hectare times the Stated Period. Edition n lasts until the count reaches SCALE x (F1^2 + ... + Fn^2), F being the Fibonacci numbers 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...; past the twelfth it stays in edition 12. A covenant takes the edition current when it activates and keeps it. A cancelled covenant's land leaves the count. LIMITS (Lifecycle v5 §5). Each EFT's base TR3 is capped at 1,000,000, so at the current edition: longest term 100 x F / hectares years, rounded down, kept between 3 and 100 smallest land 0.1 x F ha largest land 33.33 x F ha (3 years) THE REWARD. Over its whole term a covenant earns hectares x 100 x years x ecoScore / F TR3, at most 1,000,000, times its overcharge multiplier. It accrues evenly from the term's start to its end: patron (the EFT's owner) 90%, guardian 10%, of which the referrer takes 30% No TR3 goes to a referrer who is a verifier, a Trust Admin or a GTA: its share stays with the guardian. WHAT STOPS IT a drip freeze accrual is clamped at the moment of the freeze, and back-pays when it is lifted a block the same: "instalments and TR3 stop" (§10); what was earned before it stays claimable a cancellation accrual ends for good, at the block or the freeze, whichever began first; what was earned up to there stays claimable A re-score or an overcharge changes the rate from that moment on, never what was already earned.

contracts.notice: A patron who holds an EFT whose term has ended can burn its value, as fuel, into a covenant of a later edition: overcharge an expired EFT of edition e fuels a covenant of edition t > e (t at least 3): the rest of the target's term earns TR3 at t - e + 1 times its rate, at most F(t) times transmute two expired EFTs of the same edition e (at least 2) make one virtual fuel of edition e - 1 transmute two virtual fuels of the same edition do the same, and so on down to edition 1 One overcharge per covenant. functions.details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.
functions.access: Anyone; the function checks its own rules

functions.name: paused
functions.details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

functions.name: proxiableUUID
functions.details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

contracts.name: EcoLens
contracts.title: EcoLens -- read-only views for the portal
contracts.notice: One call for each screen: what a request in a country costs and allows, where a request stands, and everything about a covenant. Holds nothing and changes nothing; it reads the directory from Admin, so it never needs reconfiguring.

roles.name: FOUNDATION
roles.doc: The Foundation: configuration, the pause, and the bootstrap of the first GTAs. AccessControl's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so it also administers every other role.

roles.name: SERVER
roles.doc: The backend service account: identity checks, fiat-paid requests, the emergency Holder freeze.

roles.name: HOLDER
roles.doc: A country Trust Admin -- the Holder of the covenants its verifiers verify.

roles.name: GUARDIAN
